blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models sometimes produce correct outputs even when their inputs are corrupted by deletion, replacement, or misspelling. We study the internal processes accompanying this behavior, which we call context restoration, in controlled attention-only transformers and five pretrained LLMs (1B–32B parameters) across arithmetic, reading comprehension, and multiple-choice reasoning tasks. In the attention-only transformers, restoration emerges spontaneously despite training exclusively on clean sequences, without corruption training or an explicit denoising objective. We find that context restoration follows a two-phase process: early layers localize effects associated with repair at corrupted positions, while later layers accumulate these effects at uncorrupted positions through the residual stream and ultimately concentrate them at the output position. Repair outcome is predictable from hidden states: cosine alignment with the clean state is highly predictive in attention-only models, while linear probes recover additional information in pretrained LLMs. A linear probe using only the corrupted prompt’s first-block hidden state predicts failure with mean ROC-AUC 0.78. This enables failure triage under matched or even partially shifted deployment conditions and may reduce unnecessary verification or computation. Failed examples also show substantially greater nonlinearity along corruption directions. Moderate-corruption finetuning increases corruption tolerance while simultaneously reducing displacement-normalized linearization error, associating improved robustness with a more nearly linear response to corruption.
blocks.zh: 语言模型有时会产生正确的输出,即使其输入被删除,替换,或错拼所腐蚀. 我们研究与这种行为相关的内部过程,我们称之为上下文恢复,在可控的只注意的变压器和五个预先训练的LLM(1B-32B参数)中,跨越算术,阅读理解和多重选择推理任务. 在只注意的变压器中,尽管只进行清洁序列培训,但没有进行腐败培训或明确宣布目标,但自发恢复。 我们发现背景恢复遵循两个阶段的过程:早期层将修复损坏位置的相关效应本地化,而后层则通过残余流在未损坏位置积累这些效应,最终将其集中在输出位置. 修补结果从隐藏状态中可以预测:与清洁状态的余弦配合在只注意模型中是高度预测的,而线性探测器则在预先训练的LLMs中恢复额外信息. 线性探测器只使用腐烂的导体的第一块隐藏状态预测故障,使用平均值ROC-AUC 0.78. 这将使在匹配或甚至部分改变部署条件下进行故障分解成为可能,并可能减少不必要的核查或计算。 失败的例子也表明,在腐败方向上,非线性大大加强。 适度的腐败微调提高了腐败的容忍度,同时减少了流离失所 -- -- 正常的线性化错误,将增强的稳健性与对腐败的更接近线性的反应联系起来。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: When an input is corrupted, a key word is deleted, a number in a sequence is replaced, or a sentence is interrupted by irrelevant text, a language model sometimes behaves as if it had seen the uncorrupted input. It may still produce the same answer as it would have produced from the original prompt. Whether accuracy survives the perturbation, measured at the output alone, does not capture what is happening here: the model must preserve the task-relevant computation despite receiving damaged input, and matching outputs alone do not show whether it did. This creates an oversight problem: when robustness fails, the failure may be silent, so a deployed system needs a way to identify inputs at elevated risk before acting on the model’s output. This matters in practice because real inputs are often affected by OCR errors, speech-transcription errors, formatting artifacts, tool-call failures, copy-paste noise, and adversarial edits ( Singh, Singh, and Vatsal 2024 ; Wang et al. 2024 ; McCoy, Pavlick, and Linzen 2019 ; Petroni et al. 2020 ; Zhou, Li, and Wang 2024 ) . Understanding how models preserve correct behavior under such corruption can help distinguish deployed systems that are genuinely robust from those that will fail silently under distributional shift and inform training procedures that promote reliable recovery ( Wang, Wang, and Yang 2022 ) . A mechanism that estimates failure risk before generation could support selective clarification or verification rather than treating every corrupted input as unreliable.
blocks.zh: 当一个输入被腐蚀,一个关键词被删除,一个序列中的数字被替换,或者一个句子被不相关的文本打断时,一个语言模型有时表现得好像它已经看到了未腐蚀的输入. 它可能仍然产生与最初的即时反应相同的答案。 精确度是否幸存下来,仅以输出量来衡量,并不能捕捉到这里正在发生的情况:模型虽然接收了损坏的输入,但必须保留与任务相关的计算,单匹配输出并不能显示它是否做到了. 这造成了一个监督问题:当稳健性失败时,失败可能是沉默的,所以部署的系统需要一种方法,在对模型的输出采取行动之前确定风险较高的投入. 这在实际中很重要,因为实际输入经常受到OCR错误,语音调试错误,格式化文物,工具调用故障,抄袭噪音,以及对抗性编辑的影响(Singh, Singh, and Vatsal 2024; Wang et al. 2024; McCoy, Pavlick, and Linzen 2019; Petroni et al. 2020; 周, 李, 王2024 (中文(简体) ). 了解模型如何在这种腐败下保持正确行为有助于区分真正强大的部署系统与那些在分配转变下静悄悄地失败的部署系统,并为促进可靠恢复的培训程序提供信息(王、王和杨2022)。 在产生失败风险之前估算失败风险的机制可以支持有选择地澄清或核查,而不是将每一个腐败的投入视为不可靠。

blocks.en: We call this phenomenon spontaneous context restoration : the preservation of correct task-relevant computation under label-preserving corruption of input content. In our attention-only transformer models, this behavior emerges despite the model being trained exclusively on clean sequences and never trained to recover from corrupted inputs. We trace where corrupted information first matters inside the network, how effects associated with repair move across positions, and what geometric properties of internal representations separate examples that restore from examples that fail. We study controlled attention-only transformers (4- and 10-layer) trained on arithmetic sequences alongside five pretrained instruction-tuned LLMs spanning 1B–32B parameters, evaluated on ARC-Challenge ( Clark et al. 2018 ) , factual QA ( Rajpurkar et al. 2016 ) , and CommonsenseQA ( Talmor et al. 2019 ) under four corruption modes (dropout, replacement, spelling, distractor injection).
blocks.zh: 我们称这种现象是自发的上下文恢复:在保留输入内容的标签腐败下保留正确的与任务有关的计算。 在我们只关注的变压器模型中,尽管该模型只接受过清洁序列的训练,并且从未接受过从腐烂的投入中恢复过来的训练,但这种行为还是出现了. 我们追踪网络内哪些信息被破坏, 与修复有关的效果如何跨位置移动, 以及内部代表的几何属性, 我们研究只注意控制的变压器(4层和10层),与5个经过预先训练的指令调制的LLMs并列,它们跨越1B-32B参数,分别根据ARC-Challenge(Clark等人,2018年),事实QA(Rajpurkar等人,2016年),以及CommonsenseQA(Talmor等人,2019年)四种腐败模式(弹出,替换,拼写,分心注射)进行评估.

blocks.en:
Our central finding is that behaviorally context restoration follows a two-phase
spatial process shared between architectures and tasks:
early layers localize the influence of replacing corrupted-run activations with their clean counterparts at corrupted positions, while with depth this effect shifts toward clean context positions and ultimately concentrates at the prediction position. Ablating attention heads leaves repair largely intact, indicating that it draws on the accumulated residual stream rather than any single specialized head. The repair outcome is predicted by the geometry of the residual stream: in controlled attention-only transformer models, the cosine similarity between the corrupted and the clean states reaches AUC 0.80–0.95 at fixed corruption severity, while in pretrained models linear probes recover features invisible to directional metrics alone. Using only the corrupted prompt’s first-block hidden state, a linear probe achieves a mean AUC of 0.78 across models, tasks, corruption modes, and corruption levels. Flagging the 10% of inputs assigned the highest failure risk yields a mean 2.6 × 2.6\times recall lift over random selection, allowing selective clarification or verification before full generation. A linearization analysis (i.e. how closely a first-order Taylor approximation predicts the true effect of corruption on the output) shows that failed examples exhibit greater nonlinearity along corruption directions than repaired examples. Consistent with this account, moderate-corruption finetuning in the controlled model reduces curvature along corruption directions and the corruption level tolerated at 50% accuracy increases from 40% to 90% without measurable loss of clean accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们的核心发现是行为环境的恢复 遵循两个阶段
架构和任务之间共享的空间过程:
早期地层将腐败运行激活器在腐败位置替换为清洁对应器的影响力本地化,而这种效应在深度上转向清洁上下文位置,最终集中在预测位置. 散开的注意力头留下的修复基本上完好无损,表明它借鉴了积存的残流而不是任何单一的专门头部. 修复结果通过残余流的几何学预测:在受控的只注意的变压器模型中,腐烂状态和清洁状态之间的余弦相似性在固定的腐败严重性下达到AUC 0.80–0.95,而在预先训练的模型线性探测器中恢复了光是方向度量所看不见的特征. 一个线性探测器仅使用腐败的导火线的第一屏蔽状态,就实现了平均0.78的AUC, 跨越模型、任务、腐败模式和腐败程度。 标出10%的指定失败风险最高的输入值时,平均为2.6×2.6\时,会比随机选择时重回升降,允许在全部生成前进行选择性澄清或核查。 线性化分析(即一阶泰勒近似预测腐败对产出的真正影响的程度)显示,失败的例子在腐败方向上表现出比修复的例子更明显的非线性. 与这一说法一致的是,控制模式中度的腐败微调会沿着腐败方向降低曲率,容忍的腐败水平的准确度从40%上升到90%,而不会明显地丧失准确性。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of spontaneous context restoration. Patching effects shift across positions with depth, hidden states distinguish repaired from failed inputs, and early representations support failure triage before generation.
blocks.zh: 图 1:自发环境修复概况. 补丁效果在有深度的位置之间发生转变,隐藏状态将修复的输入与失败的输入区分开来,早期的表示支持生成前的失败分解.

blocks.en: Our contributions are : (1) we show that context restoration emerges spontaneously in models trained only on clean sequences and characterize its two-phase spatial organization across attention-only and pretrained transformers, localizing where corrupted information matters and how effects associated with repair shift to the prediction position; (2) we show that repair outcome is predictable from residual-stream geometry and linearly decodable from the corrupted prompt’s early hidden state before output generation, enabling selective verification of inputs most likely to fail rather than treating all corrupted inputs as unreliable; (3) we show that failed examples exhibit greater nonlinearity along corruption directions, and that corruption finetuning jointly increases robustness and reduces linearization error.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(1) 我们显示,环境恢复自发地出现在只受过清洁序列培训的模型中,并描述其两阶段空间组织跨越只注意和预先受过训练的变压器,将损坏的信息问题定位在什么地方,以及与修复转变到预测位置有关的效果;(2) 我们显示,从剩余流几何学上可以预测修复结果,并且从腐败的推动者在产出产生之前的早期隐藏状态上可以线性解码,从而能够有选择地核查最有可能失败的投入,而不是将所有损坏的投入视为不可靠;(3) 我们显示,失败的例子表明,腐败方向上的非线性更大,腐败的微调共同增加了强性,减少了线性化错误。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Liu et al. (2024) show that model performance degrades when relevant evidence is positioned in the middle of long contexts. Min et al. (2022) decompose prompts into components and find that some can be semantically corrupted without destroying performance. Abedin et al. (2025) show that punctuation-only corruption, which preserves all lexical content, still degrades math reasoning. Noisy-rationale and prompt-perturbation studies ( Zhou et al. 2024 ; Anantheswaran et al. 2024 ; Chatziveroglou, Yun, and Kelleher 2025 ) report smooth degradation with noise and partial mitigation via prompting or finetuning. A separate line examines context faithfulness versus parametric priors: Neeman et al. (2023) formalize persuasion and susceptibility metrics, and Ortu et al. (2024) trace how factual recall and in-context counterfactual repetition compete internally. All of these are primarily behavioral; they do not characterize the internal processes associated with successful performance under corruption.
blocks.zh: 刘等人(2024年)表示,模型性能在相关证据处于长期背景中的位置时会退化. Min等人(2022年)将导火索分解为组件,发现部分元件可以在不破坏性能的情况下被分解腐烂. Abedin等人(2025年)表明,保留所有词汇内容的只标注的腐败,仍然贬低数学推理. 噪音-定量和即时扰动研究(周等). 2024年; Anantheswaran et al. 2024年; 查齐韦罗格卢, Yun,和Kelleher 2025 )报告通过催化或微调,通过噪音平稳降解和部分缓解. 单行审查上下文的忠诚度与参数前缀: Neeman等人(2023年)正式确定了说服和易感性衡量标准,Ortu等人(2024年)追踪了事实召回和内容内反事实重复的内部竞争情况。 所有这些都主要是行为性的;它们并不说明腐败下成功业绩的内部过程。

blocks.en: Elhage et al. (2021) frame the residual stream as a shared communication channel; this view underpins our patching analyses. Circuit analyses for IOI ( Wang et al. 2022 ) , greater-than ( Hanna, Liu, and Variengien 2023 ) , and arithmetic ( Stolfo, Belinkov, and Sachan 2023 ; Yu and Ananiadou 2024 ; Zhang et al. 2024 ) localize specific behaviours to compact sets of heads and MLPs, but assume clean inputs. Activation patching ( Meng et al. 2022 ; Goldowsky-Dill et al. 2023 ; Heimersheim and Nanda 2024 ; Zhang and Nanda 2023 ) and sparse autoencoders ( Bricken et al. 2023 ; Olah et al. 2020 ) provide the causal and feature-level tools we use. Lad et al. (2024) report that deleting or swapping middle layers preserves 72–95% of predictions and hypothesise four stages of inference; this is consistent with our finding that middle layers are where effects associated with repair redistribute.
blocks.zh: Elhage等人(2021年)将剩余流作为共享交流渠道;这种观点是我们补丁分析的基础。 对IOI(Wang等人,2022年),Great-than(Hanna,Liu,和Variengien,2023年),以及算术(Stolfo,Belinkov,和Sachan,2023年;Yu和Ananiadou,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年)的电路分析,将特定行为本地化为紧凑的组合头部和MLP,但承担干净的投入. 激活补丁(Meng等人,2022年;Goldowsky-Dill等人). 2023; 海默斯海姆和南达 2024; 张和南达 2023)和稀疏的自动编码器(Bricken et al. 2023年;Olah等人,2020年)提供了我们使用的因果和特征级工具. Lad 等 (英语). (2024年)报告删除或交换中间层保留了72-95%的预测和假设四个阶段的推论;这符合我们的结论,即中间层与修复相关的影响在其中重新分配。

blocks.en: The Hydra Effect ( McGrath et al. 2023 ) shows that ablating one layer induces compensation elsewhere. Rushing and Nanda (2024) expand this across model families, identifying LayerNorm scaling and anti-erasure neurons as partial mechanisms. These studies examine compensation after internal ablation (removed heads or layers). We study recovery from external , label-preserving input corruption as a related but distinct problem.
blocks.zh: 水合物效应(McGrath等人,2023年)表明,分层造成其他地方的补偿。 Rushing和Nanda(2024年)将此扩展至模范家庭,将LayerNorm缩放和抗衰老神经元确定为局部机制. 这些研究研究了内部衰竭(被拆掉的头部或层)后的补偿. 我们研究从外部的、保留标签的输入腐败中回收,这是一个相关但独特的问题。

blocks.en: The tuned lens ( Belrose et al. 2023 ) decodes every layer in vocabulary space, treating the transformer computation as an iterative refinement. Marks and Tegmark (2023) and Shai et al. (2024) show that task-relevant information can form linear structures in the residual-stream. Engels et al. (2024) show that some features occupy subspaces of higher dimensions rather than single directions. Our linearization analysis measures functional curvature along the corruption direction, linking representation geometry to repair outcome.
blocks.zh: 调制镜头(Belrose等人,2023年)在词汇空间中解码每层,将变压器计算视为迭代完善. Marks和Tegmark (2023)和Shai等人 (2024)显示,与任务相关的信息可以在残余流中形成线性结构. Engels等人(2024年)表明,一些特征占据了更高维度的子空间,而不是单向. 我们的线性化分析沿腐败方向测量功能曲率,将代表几何学与修复结果联系起来.

blocks.en: Training on noisy or perturbed inputs has been shown to improve robustness across NLP models and LLMs ( Gupta et al. 2024 ; Alajrami, Tan, and Aletras 2025 ; Liu et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026 ) . Our work differs by varying the severity of corruption during finetuning and relating the resulting robustness gains to changes in linearization error along corruption directions. We also compare the setting in which models are trained only on clean inputs with one in which they are further finetuned on corrupted inputs.
blocks.zh: 事实证明,关于噪音或扰动投入的培训提高了NLP模型和LLMs的稳健性(Gupta等人,2024年;Alajrami、Tan和Aletras 2025年;Liu等人)。 2026; 张等 2026). 我们的工作不同,在微调过程中腐败的严重程度不同,并将由此产生的强劲收益与腐败方向线性化错误的变化联系起来。 我们还将只接受清洁投入培训的模式与进一步调整腐败投入的模式进行比较。

blocks.en: We train two attention-only decoder-only transformers from scratch in clean sequences (Supplementary Figure 1.1): a small 4-layer model (1.75M parameters) and a large 10-layer model (4.01M parameters), both with 8 heads and a vocabulary of 13,008 tokens. Integer token indices are randomly permuted in tokeniser construction, forcing the model to learn the numerical structure from context. The 10-layer model is used for main analyses; the 4-layer model verifies depth-independence and replicates main findings. For each experimental condition, we evaluated 100 held-out disjoint sequences; accuracy is the exact match to the clean target. The architecture and training details are in the Supplementary Content 1 & 2.

blocks.en: Natural-Language Setting: Pretrained language models on NLP tasks
blocks.zh: 自然语言设置: NLP 任务的预训语言模型

blocks.en: We evaluated five instruction-tuned LLMs: Gemma-3-1B-IT ( Google 2025 ) , OLMo-2-7B-Instruct ( Allen Institute for AI 2025 ) , Llama-3-8B-Instruct ( Meta 2024 ) , Qwen3-32B ( Qwen Team 2025 ) , and Gemma-4-31B-IT ( Google 2026 ) , using greedy decoding without system prompt. The task families are ARC-Challenge (multiple-choice science), Factual QA (SQuAD-derived extractive reading comprehension) and CommonsenseQA (multiple-choice commonsense reasoning), with up to 500 examples per task filtered to ≤ \leq 250 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五个指令调试的LLMS:Gemma-3-1B-IT(Google 2025),OLMo-2-7B-Instruct(Allen Institute for AI 2025),Llama-3-8B-Instruct(Meta 2024),Qune3-32B. (Quen Team 2025),以及Gemma-4-31B-IT (Google 2026),使用贪婪的解码而无需系统及时. 任务家族包括ARC-Challenge(多选择科学)、Fact QA(SQuAD-衍生的采掘读取理解)和CommonsenseQA(多选择常识推理),每个任务过滤到\\\leq 250令牌最多500个实例.

blocks.en: Each prompt is split into ( user_prefix , corruption_region , user_suffix ); only the corruption region is modified while supporting tokens (such as "Question", "Answer", "Context", etc.), answer choices, and target answer span within the context passage are protected, ensuring label-preserving corruption. We apply four corruption modes at rates r ∈ { 10 , 30 , 50 , 70 , 90 , 100 } % r\in\{10,30,50,70,90,100\}\% : dropout (word deletion), replacement (substitution with function words), spelling (internal character shuffling) and distractor (interleaving irrelevant sentences). The corruption rate is defined relative to the token count of the clean corruption region.
blocks.zh: 每个提示被拆分为(用户_prefix, corruption_region, user_safdix) ;只有腐败区域在支持符号(如"问","答","Context"等)时被修改,答案选择,上下文段落中的目标答案跨度被保护,确保了标签保存腐败. 我们采用四种腐败模式, 比率为 r { 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 100 }% r\ in 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 100 } : 退出(删除字), 替换(用函数词替代), 拼写( 内部字符洗牌) 和分散注意力( 中断无关的句子) 。 腐败率是相对于清洁腐败区域的象征性数字确定的。

blocks.en: Accuracy degrades monotonically with corruption rate in both settings; dropout and replacement are the most destructive, spelling is milder, distractor corruption is weakest, and factual QA is the most fragile task (Supplementary Figure 5.7).
blocks.zh: 准确性在两种情况下都以腐败率单调降解;辍学和替代最具破坏性,拼写更为温和,分散注意力的腐败最弱,事实上的QA是最脆弱的任务(补充图5.7)。

blocks.en: We evaluate using exact match, F1 score (the harmonic mean of token precision and recall after text normalization, taking the maximum over all the available phrasings of the gold answers) and token agreement (whether clean and corrupted prompts produce the same sequence of generated tokens). We term an instance repaired when the corrupted input produces the correct answer (operationalized as exact match, F ​ 1 ≥ 0.5 F1\geq 0.5 , or token agreement depending on the analysis). When repair occurs in models trained on clean sequences without corruption priors, as in our controlled setting, we call it spontaneous context restoration as opposed to context restoration in pretrained models where parametric knowledge may also contribute.
blocks.zh: 我们使用精确的匹配,F1分(在文本正常化后,表示符号精度和召回的谐调平均值,在黄金答案的所有可用措辞上占据最大值)和符号协议(无论干净和腐败的提示产生生成符号的序列)来评价. 我们用一个被损坏的输入产生正确答案(精确匹配,F 1 = 0.5 F1\ geq 0.5,或根据分析结果达成象征性协议)时修复的实例。 当修复发生在未经腐败前科培训的清洁序列模型中时,如在我们控制的环境下,我们称之为自发的上下文修复,而不是在参数化知识也可能有所贡献的预先培训模型中进行上下文修复。

blocks.en: Analysis Methods
blocks.zh: 分析方法

blocks.en: This section defines the tools applied in both settings. In the controlled attention-only transformer models, we cache activations at two sites per layer: attention output before the skip connection and after residual addition. In pretrained models, we hook at the output of each transformer block. All analyses read from the last (prediction) token position unless otherwise noted. Full procedural details are in Supplementary Content 1 & 2.
blocks.zh: 本节定义两种设置中应用的工具. 在受控的只注意的变压器模型中,我们在每层两个站点进行缓存激活:跳过连接前的注意输出和剩余添加后. 在预先训练的模型中,我们在每个变压器块的输出上挂钩. 除非另有说明,所有分析都从最后(预测)符号位置读取。 全部程序细节见补充内容1和2。

blocks.en: To localize which positions carry repair-relevant information at each layer, we run the corrupted input and replace activations at a subset of positions with their clean counterparts, measuring the resulting change in the target-token logit ( Elhage et al. 2021 ) . In the controlled model, patching is performed at both hook sites; in pretrained models, at the layer output. Positions are partitioned into corrupted and clean groups, patched separately. Because this requires token-aligned sequences, patching in the pretrained setting uses only replacement and spelling corruptions.
blocks.zh: 为了确定哪些位置在每一层都载有与修理有关的信息,我们运行了腐烂的输入器,并在一组位置用干净的对应器替换激活器,以衡量目标端对数的变化(Elhage等人,2021年)。 在受控模型中,补丁在两个钩点进行;在预先训练的模型中,在层输出. 位置被分割为腐败和清洁的组, 单独补丁 。 由于这需要符号对齐序列,在预训设置中的补丁只使用替换和拼写腐败.

blocks.en: At each layer ℓ \ell , we compute the cosine similarity cos ℓ \cos_{\ell} between the corrupted and clean activations at the prediction position before and after residual addition in the controlled model; layer output in pretrained models, measuring the angular alignment with the clean trajectory. To assess whether the repair outcome is predictable from intermediate representations, we train two probes: (1) a cosine probe using cos ℓ \cos_{\ell} as a single scalar feature and (2) a logistic regression linear probe on the full d d -dimensional corrupted activation with 5-fold stratified cross-validation. A separate is-corrupted probe predicts whether an input is corrupted vs. clean, measuring when corruption identity becomes linearly decodable.

blocks.en: Key Findings
blocks.zh: 主要调查结果

blocks.en: Where does repair happen? Repair Signals Shift from Corrupted to Clean Positions
blocks.zh: 修理在哪里进行? 修复信号从损坏位置移到干净位置

blocks.en: Activation patching at individual positions reveals two distinct phases. In the 10-layer model at layer 0, corrupted positions produce approximately 20 × 20\times larger patching effects than clean positions (Figure 2 , top); this effect decays sharply with distance downstream of the nearest corrupted tokens. The patching effect is defined as the mean absolute change in the correct-token logit per patched position. By layers 3–4 the pattern reverses: clean positions carry the dominant effect, and corrupted positions approach the zero effect. Very few positions carry the maximum of the effect, and by the late layers, nearly all effects concentrate at the prediction position: the model routes information from distributed positions to clean positions especially at the single readout. Because the readout position is clean by construction, we analyzed it separately from other clean positions. The crossover persists after excluding the prediction position; however, the final prediction position has an effect 17 × 17\times larger than the other clean positions (Supplementary Figure 5.9, 5.10, 5.11). This structure replicates in pretrained models: corrupted positions dominate early layers on all three tasks, while clean positions take over later (Figures 2 bottom, Supplementary Figure 5.12). The depth of the crossover varies by task, but the qualitative pattern is preserved.
blocks.zh: 单个位置的激活补丁显示出两个不同的阶段。 在0层的10层模型中,腐烂的位置产生约20×20\次比干净位置更大的补丁效果(图2,顶部);这种效果随着最近的腐烂的代币的下游距离而急剧衰变. 补丁效应的定义是每补丁位置的正确键对数的平均绝对变化. 3–4层的图案倒置:干净的姿势带有主导效应,腐烂的姿势接近零效应. 极少数位置承载着最大效应,到后层,几乎所有效应都集中在预测位置:模型路径信息从分布位置到清洁位置,特别是在单读位置. 因为读取位置是干净的 通过建筑, 我们分析它和其他干净的位置。 在排除了预测位置后,交叉持续;然而,最终预测位置的效果比其他清洁位置大17×17\时(补充图5.9,5.10,5.11)。 这种结构在预先训练过的模型中复制:腐败的姿势在所有三个任务中都占据了早期的层位,而干净的姿势则在后期占据(图2底层,补充图5.12). 交叉的深度因任务而异,但质量模式得以保留.

blocks.en:
Decomposing the patching effect into the current layer’s attention output (before residual addition) and the full accumulated state (after residual addition) indicates that effects associated with successful repair accumulate progressively in the residual stream (Figure 2 top, Supplementary Figure 5.11).
At corrupted positions in layer 0, the skip connection accounts for most of the effect, showing that the clean patch is carried forward primarily through the residual path rather than being modified by additional attention computation. At clean positions, each layer’s attention contributes a roughly uniform increment, while the skip-connection contribution grows steadily from layers 0 through 4.
blocks.zh:
将补丁效应分解为当前层的注意力输出(在剩余添加之前)和全部累积状态(在剩余添加之后)表明,与成功修复相关的效应在剩余流中逐步积累(图2,补充图5.11)。
在第0层中已损坏的位置,跳过连接占了效果的大部分,表明干净的补丁主要是通过剩余路径结转的,而不是通过额外的注意计算来修改. 在干净的姿势下,每一层的注意力都促成大致一致的递增,而跳转连接的贡献则从0到4层稳步增长.

blocks.en: In the controlled model, ablating 4, 6, or 8 of 8 heads at a single target layer leaves accuracy close to the no-ablation baseline when averaged over target layers (Supplementary Table 4.4), so repair does not depend on any individual layer-local head subset at this scale.
blocks.zh: 在控制模型中,单目标层的4,6或8个头在平均超过目标层时会留下接近无比基线的精度(补充表4.4),因此修复不依赖于这个尺度上的任何单个层-局部头子集.

blocks.en: Why does repair fail? Failures Encounter High Curvature Along Corruption Trajectories
blocks.zh: 为什么修理失败? 腐败轨迹沿线的高曲率遭遇失败

blocks.en: Figure 3: Linearization residuals in the pretrained models. Repaired examples stay close to locally linear behavior near the clean trajectory, while failed examples show much larger residuals at larger interpolation steps.
blocks.zh: 图3:预训型号中的线性残余. 修补的例子接近清洁轨迹附近的局部线性行为,而失败的例子则显示在更大的内插步骤下存在更大的残余.

blocks.en:
First-order predictions ( Δ ​ g p ​ r ​ e ​ d . \Delta g_{pred.} ) closely match the true logit change ( Δ ​ g t ​ r ​ u ​ e . \Delta g_{true.} ) at α = 0.25 \alpha=0.25 for both repaired and failed examples, indicating that the logit map is locally approximately linear near the clean representation (Figure 3 top). At α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 , the two groups separate sharply: failed examples show approximately 8 × 8\times larger linearization residuals than repaired examples. The residual grows with both corruption rate and interpolation distance, producing a trumpet-shaped fan as the examples move farther from the clean trajectory (Supplementary Figure 5.17). This pattern appears in all tested LLMs and controlled models (Supplementary Figure 5.18, 5.19).
At layer 0, the repaired and failed examples are nearly indistinguishable between step sizes. By the final layer, failed examples exhibit approximately 6 − 8 × 6-8\times larger residuals than repaired examples at α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 , while the gap remains small at α = 0.25 \alpha=0.25 . The linearization residual increases with depth for both repaired and failed examples, but substantially faster for failed examples across all four pretrained models (Supplementary Table 4.7).

blocks.en: A natural alternative is that failed examples simply undergo larger or more sensitive displacements rather than entering more curved regions. The interpolation sweep suggests that displacement magnitude or first-order sensitivity alone is insufficient to explain the difference: the ratio of failed to repaired linearization residuals grows with step size, from ≈ 2 × {\approx}2\times at α = 0.25 \alpha=0.25 to ≈ 4 × {\approx}4\times at α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 (Figure 3 ). A first-order sensitivity or displacement difference would produce a constant ratio across α \alpha ; curvature produces a higher-order effect, scaling approximately as α 2 \alpha^{2} , and therefore predicts this growth. Together, these results associate repair failure with increasing departure from locally linear behavior as corrupted representations move away from the clean state.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的替代办法是,失败的例子只是发生更大或更敏感的迁移,而不是进入更多曲折的区域。 插值扫描表明,仅是位移量或第一阶敏感度不足以解释差异:修复线性化残基失败的比例随步长而增加,从α=0.25\alpha=0.25到α=1.0(图3). 一阶灵敏度或位移差将产生α-α之间的恒定比;曲率产生更高阶效应,大致缩放为α-2-α-2},因此可以预测这种增长。 这些结果加在一起,将修复失败与随着腐败的代表逐渐脱离清洁状态而日益偏离当地线性行为联系起来。

blocks.en: What distinguishes repair from failure? Repair Outcome Is Decodable from Residual-State Representations
blocks.zh: 修理与故障有什么区别? 剩余国家代表处可解码

blocks.en: The cosine similarity between corrupted and clean activations at the prediction position separates repaired from failed examples. In the 10-layer controlled model, the repaired examples maintain cosine similarity cos ℓ ≈ 0.95 \cos_{\ell}\approx 0.95 across layers, while failed examples diverge to ≈ 0.40 {\approx}0.40 by the final layer (Supplementary Figure 5.13). The gap grows with depth, indicating that successful repair preserves the clean residual direction, while failure corresponds to angular drift away from it. This cosine alignment of activations is predictive of repair at the per-example level. The within-ablation AUC (computed by training and evaluating the probe separately within each corruption rate) for cosine similarity reaches 0.80–0.95 across layers and corruption modes in the controlled setting (Figure 4 bottom). This controls for corruption severity: because more corruption makes repair less likely, a probe trained across rates could predict repair merely by reading off how corrupted the input is. Training within a fixed rate removes this confounding factor, so the above-chance AUC reflects genuine repair-predictive structure rather than severity. See Supplementary Figure 5.14.
blocks.zh: 预测位置上损坏的和干净的激活之间的余弦相似性将修复的和失败的例子分开. 在10层控制模型中,修复的示例保持了余弦相似性,因为l\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\> 0.95 跨层,而失败的例子则在末层上与 \ 0.40\ 0.40\ 相异(补充图5.13)。 差距随深度而扩大,表明成功的修复保留了干净的残留方向,而故障则对应角向漂移远离. 这种对激活的余弦配合,在每例水平上可以预测修复. 内部的AUC(通过在每个腐败率范围内分别进行训练和评估调查计算),对同位素相似性的调查达到0.80-0.95,在控制环境下的腐败模式(图4下方)。 这种对腐败严重性的控制:由于更多的腐败使得修复的可能性降低,经过不同费率培训的探测器只能通过了解输入的腐败程度来预测修复。 固定费率内的培训消除了这一混乱因素,因此上述AUC反映了真正的修理预测结构而不是严重性。 见补充图5.14。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Hidden states predict repair outcome. Top: Qwen3-32B on ARC under replacement corruption. Bottom: controlled model under in-range ablation.
blocks.zh: 图 4:隐藏状态预测修复结果. 顶级:在替换腐败下ARC上的Quen3-32B. 底部:受控型号,位于距离弯曲下.

blocks.en: In pretrained models, the pattern becomes task- and corruption-dependent. Cosine similarity probes still reveal late-layer drift for failed examples, especially under destructive corruptions such as dropout and replacement on factual QA. However, for milder corruptions such as distractor insertion and spelling, and for ARC and CommonsenseQA more broadly, correct and failed trajectories often remain close in cosine space. Thus, global angular alignment captures part of the information predictive of repair, but is not sufficient in all settings (Supplementary Figure 5.16).
blocks.zh: 在经过预先培训的模式中,这种模式成为任务和腐败的依赖。 余弦相似性探测器仍然揭示出晚期对失败例子的漂移,特别是在破坏性腐败下,如辍学和在事实上的QA上替换. 然而,对于更温和的腐败,如分心器插入和拼写,对于ARC和CommonsenseQA更广义而言,正确和失败的轨迹往往仍然在余弦空间中保持接近. 因此,全球角对齐捕捉部分对修复工作的信息预测,但并非在所有情况下都足够(补充图5.16)。

blocks.en: Corruption detection is near-ceiling (AUC ≈ 0.96 − 1.00 \approx 0.96-1.00 ) from the earliest layers across pretrained models and corruption modes (Supplementary Table 4.6) indicating that the weaker and more task-dependent separation of repaired from failed examples reflects distinct hidden-state information rather than mere corruption detection. Controlled-model corruption-detection results show the same distinction (Supplementary Figure 5.15).
blocks.zh: 对腐败的侦查几乎是最高的(AUC 0.96 − 1.00 \ 大约 0.96-1.00),它跨越预先训练过的模型和腐败模式的最早层(补充表4.6),表明修复后与失败实例之间较弱和更依赖于任务的分离反映了明显的隐蔽状态信息,而不仅仅是腐败的侦查。 受控模式的腐败侦查结果也显示出同样的区别(补充图5.15)。

blocks.en:
The linear repair-success probe outperforms cosine in pretrained models compared to controlled models (Figure 4 ).
This suggests that pretrained models contain information predictive of repair in feature subspaces beyond global angular alignment. The controlled model therefore isolates a cleaner geometric repair signature compared to pretrained models. This could be due to controlled models being attention-only, as they lack MLPs, so all repair-relevant information must be encoded in residual-stream directions that attention can read and write. We hypothesize that pretrained models encode repair-relevant features in representations shaped by both MLP layers and task priors acquired during pretraining, which a single angular metric cannot capture.

blocks.en: Can failure be predicted before generation? Early Hidden States Support Deployable Failure Triage
blocks.zh: 能否在一代人之前预测失败? 早期隐藏国支持可部署失败

blocks.en: The preceding analyses establish that repair outcome is encoded in intermediate representations, but not every diagnostic is available in deployment. In particular, cosine similarity requires a clean version of the input, which is generally unavailable when a prompt is received. We therefore evaluate a deployable variant that uses only the hidden state produced by the corrupted prompt at the final prompt position. A linear probe reads this state from an early transformer layer and estimates the probability that the model will fail to recover the correct answer. It requires neither a clean reference input nor completion of output generation.
blocks.zh: 上述分析证实,修复结果在中间表述中编码,但并非所有诊断都可用。 特别是,同位素相似性需要清版的输入,当收到一个提示时,一般无法使用. 因此,我们评价一种可部署的变体,它只使用腐烂的迅速者在最后迅速位置上产生的隐藏状态。 一个线性探测器从早期的变压器层读取这个状态,并估计模型无法恢复正确答案的概率. 它既不需要干净的参考投入,也不需要完成产出生成。

blocks.en: When corruption rates are pooled, the layer-0 probe achieves a mean ROC-AUC between 0.749 and 0.797 across the five pretrained models, with later early layers providing only small and inconsistent improvements (Figure 5 , Supplementary Figure 5.21). This makes the first transformer layer the most economical operating point. Under a policy that flags the 10% of inputs assigned the highest failure risk by the probe, the probe identifies 16.4–33.4% of all failures, corresponding to a 1.64–3.34 × \times recall lift over random selection. The flagged subset has 57.6–76.6% failure precision. Thus, a system could selectively request a cleaner input, rerun the prompt, or invoke a more expensive verification procedure for a small high-risk subset rather than treating every potentially corrupted input as unreliable.

blocks.en: The present result supports selective failure triage under matched or partially shifted deployment conditions: a low-cost failure-risk score, reserving intervention for inputs predicted to be at greatest risk.

blocks.en: Can repair robustness be improved? Moderate-Corruption Finetuning Improves Robustness
blocks.zh: 修复的坚固性能否提高? 中度腐败调整

blocks.en: We finetune the 10-layer model on corrupted sequences at five corruption rates (10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90%) and evaluate across all ablation levels (Figure 6 top). We denote a model finetuned at the corruption rate r r as FT @ r r . FT@50 gives the best robustness-clean-accuracy trade-off, increasing the corruption rate tolerated at 50% accuracy from 40% in the baseline model to 90%, while preserving clean accuracy (0.997 vs. 0.999). FT@70 gives a smaller robustness gain with a clean-accuracy cost (0.922), while FT@90 reduces clean accuracy to 0.600. Therefore, moderate corruption during finetuning expands the tolerance to corruption; excessive corruption sacrifices clean accuracy and gives weaker robustness gains. The behavioral gain is accompanied by a change in local geometry. Moderate-corruption finetuning reduces displacement-normalized linearization error along corruption directions, with the largest reduction around FT@50 (Supplementary Figure 5.22). Thus, the improvement in corruption tolerance is accompanied by a more nearly linear downstream response to corrupted representations.

blocks.en: Conclusions
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We set out to characterize how language models preserve correct task performance under corrupted inputs. In the controlled setting, the ability of context restoration emerges spontaneously: models trained exclusively on clean sequences retain substantial task performance under corruption without explicit denoising training. We then find that this has a structured depth-wise organization: the influence of patching varies across positions with depth, while repair outcome is reflected in residual-state alignment and downstream nonlinearity.
blocks.zh: 我们着手描述语言模型如何在被腐蚀的投入下保持正确的任务性能。 在受控环境中,环境恢复的能力自发出现:专门接受清洁序列培训的模型在腐败下保留大量的任务业绩,而没有明确的取消培训。 然后,我们发现这有一个结构化的深度组织:补丁的影响在深度不同的位置上有所不同,而修复结果则体现在残留状态的调整和下游的非线性。

blocks.en: Across attention-only transformers and five pretrained LLMs (1B–32B parameters), context restoration follows a shared two-phase spatial structure : early layers localize repair effects at corrupted positions, and late layers concentrate the outcome at the prediction position. In the controlled model, head ablation leaves repair accuracy close to baseline, while the broader cross-model evidence show that repair outcome is associated with properties of the accumulated residual state, including alignment with the clean state and downstream nonlinearity.
blocks.zh: 在整个只注意的变压器和5个预先训练的LLMs(1B-32B参数)中,上下文恢复遵循一个共享的两相空间结构:早期层将修复效果定位于损坏位置,后层将结果集中在预测位置. 在控制模型中,头萎缩使修复精度接近基线,而更广泛的跨模型证据表明,修复结果与累积残留状态的属性相关,包括与清洁状态和下游非线性相一致.

blocks.en:
Repair and failure differ in two aspects of residual-state geometry:
alignment with the clean trajectory and nonlinearity of the downstream logit
map along the corruption direction. Failed examples exhibit linearization residuals up to 6 − 8 × 6-8\times larger than repaired examples in the controlled analyses, with the disparity increasing along the corruption direction. In the controlled model, moderate-corruption finetuning increases the corruption level tolerated at 50% accuracy from 40% to 90% while preserving clean performance. This behavioral improvement is accompanied by a reduction in displacement-normalized linearization error along the corruption directions, linking the increased robustness to a more nearly linear downstream response.

blocks.en: The divergence between controlled and pretrained settings is itself informative. Cosine similarity alone achieves within-corruption AUC 0.80–0.95 in attention-only models, but linear probes substantially outperform cosine in pretrained models. This difference may reflect the properties of hidden-state representation introduced by MLPs and pretraining, although isolating their respective contributions requires further study ( Engels et al. 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 受控制和预先训练的设置之间的差异本身就提供了信息。 光是余弦相似性就能够在腐败中的AUC 0.80–0.95只关注模型中实现,但线性探测器在预先训练模型中远远超出余弦. 这种差异可能反映了MLPs引入的隐藏状态表现和预训的属性,尽管隔离各自的贡献需要进一步研究(Engels等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
The representation-level findings have two practical consequences. First, a linear probe using only the corrupted prompt’s early hidden state can identify a small subset of inputs at elevated failure risk before generation, allowing
them to be routed for clarification, rerunning, or more expensive verification. Second, extending prior work on corruption finetuning, we vary training corruption severity and relate robustness gains to reduced linearization error in the controlled model, while showing that LLM gains depend on task and corruption type.
blocks.zh:
代表一级的调查结果有两个实际后果。 首先,一个线性探测器,只使用腐烂的提示的早期隐藏状态,就可以在生成前在更高的失败风险中识别一小段输入,从而允许
用于澄清、重新运行或更昂贵的核查。 第二,扩大先前关于腐败的微调工作,我们对腐败的严重程度进行了不同的培训,并将稳健性收益与控制模型中减少线性化误差联系起来,同时表明LLM收益取决于任务和腐败类型。

blocks.en: Together, these results connect context restoration to the depth-wise routing and geometry of residual representations. They provide representation-level diagnostics for repair failure and show that corruption-aware finetuning can modify both robustness and the local response to corrupted representations.
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同将背景恢复与残余代表物的深度和几何方法联系起来。 它们为修复故障提供了代表性的诊断,并表明对腐败的认识微调既可以改变稳健性,也可以改变当地对腐败代表性的反应。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our controlled symbolic setting deliberately removes MLP sublayers and uses procedurally generated arithmetic sequences so that restoration can be studied in a clean attention-only regime. This makes the mechanism tractable to study, but limits direct transfer of the quantitative findings to full-architecture transformers, multilingual settings, and tasks whose targets are not preserved under local content corruption. The divergence that we observe between controlled and pretrained models where linear probes substantially outperform cosine alignment, indicates that MLP-shaped features reshape the repair geometry in ways that our attention-only analysis cannot fully characterize. In the pretrained setting, we evaluate five instruction-tuned decoder-only LLMs (1B–32B parameters) on three English-language task families under four label-preserving corruption modes. We do not evaluate mixture-of-experts, state-space, encoder-decoder, or retrieval-augmented architectures, so the generality of these geometric analyses beyond the studied settings is untested.
blocks.zh: 我们控制的符号设置有意去除 MLP 子层,并使用程序生成的算术序列,以便在一个干净的只注意的制度中研究恢复. 这使得这一机制能够进行研究,但将量化结果直接转移到全结构变压器、多语种设置和那些在本地内容腐败下无法保留目标的任务。 我们观察到,线性探测器远远超出余弦对齐的受控模型和预先训练模型之间的差异表明,MLP形状的特征重塑了修复几何学,而我们只注意的分析无法充分描述。 在预先训练的环境下,我们评价了三个英语任务家庭在四个保留标签的腐败模式下的五个指导调试解码器唯一的LLM(1B–32B参数). 我们不评估专家的混合体、状态-空间、编码器-解码器或检索-强化结构,因此,这些几何分析在所研究的设置之外的普遍性还没有经过测试。

blocks.en: S1.3 Tokeniser
blocks.zh: S1.3 托克尼泽

blocks.en: We train a byte-pair encoding (BPE) tokeniser on a minimal corpus of comma-separated digit strings, ensuring that the comma character is always segmented as its own token. We then add all integers from 0 to 13,000 as explicit single tokens, so every number in our sequences is guaranteed to be a single token. The integer token indices are randomly permuted at tokeniser construction time using the experiment seed; this forces the model to infer numerical structure from context rather than from embedding-index order. The final vocabulary contains 13,008 tokens: 13,001 integer tokens, a comma token, and 6 special tokens ( [PAD] , [UNK] , [CLS] , [SEP] , [MASK] , and a BPE merge artifact).

blocks.en: S1.9 Activation Caching
blocks.zh: S1.9 启动缓存

blocks.en: All analyses require access to intermediate hidden states. We extract activations using forward hooks registered on specific modules within each transformer layer. Two caching targets are used:
blocks.zh: 所有分析都需要进入中间隐藏状态。 我们利用在每个变压器层内特定模块上登记的前钩提取激活。 使用了两个缓冲目标:

blocks.en: 1. Residual-stream activations (after LayerNorm): Hooks are registered on the full layer module (i.e. the output of layers[ ℓ \ell ] ), which corresponds to the hidden state after the attention output has been added to the residual stream and passed through LayerNorm. These are denoted h ℓ resid ∈ ℝ T × C h_{\ell}^{\mathrm{resid}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times C} . 2. Layer-only activations (before residual addition): Hooks are registered on the self_attention submodule, capturing the attention output before it enters the residual connection. These are denoted h ℓ layer ∈ ℝ T × C h_{\ell}^{\mathrm{layer}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times C} .

blocks.en: At any layer ℓ \ell , we read out logits by applying the model’s unembedding matrix W u W_{u} to the cached activation: Logit ℓ = W u ⋅ h ℓ resid [ p , : ] ∈ ℝ V , \mathrm{Logit}_{\ell}=W_{u}\cdot h_{\ell}^{\mathrm{resid}}[p,:]\in\mathbb{R}^{V}, where V V is the vocabulary size and p p is the prediction position. blocks.en: Only corruption_region is modified under corruption. For ARC and CommonsenseQA, the corruption region is the question text; answer choices remain intact. For Factual QA, the corruption region contains both the context and question; the instruction specifying the answer format is protected. Scaffold tokens ( Context: , Question: , Answer: , Choices: ) are never corrupted. This ensures that task format and gold answer are unchanged, so that all corruptions are label-preserving.

blocks.en: We select ARC-Challenge, CommonsenseQA, and a SQuAD-derived factual QA task to cover complementary forms of language-model reasoning and context use. ARC-Challenge evaluates multiple-choice scientific reasoning, CommonsenseQA evaluates multiple-choice commonsense reasoning, and factual QA evaluates extractive reading comprehension in which the answer must be recovered from an explicit context passage. Together, these tasks allow us to test whether context restoration generalizes across different task structures and sources of task-relevant information, rather than being specific to a single benchmark or response format.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了ARC-Challenge,CommonsenseQA,以及SQAD衍生的事实QA任务,以涵盖语言模型推理和上下文使用的补充形式. ARC-Challenge评价多选择科学推理,CommonsenseQA评价多选择常识推理,事实性QA评价采掘阅读理解,其中答案必须从明确的上下文段落中恢复. 这些任务合在一起,使我们能够检验背景恢复是否涵盖不同的任务结构和与任务相关的信息来源,而不是针对单一的基准或反应格式。

blocks.en: S2.4 Corruption Modes
blocks.zh: S2.4 腐败模式

blocks.en: We apply four corruption modes at rates r ∈ { 10 , 30 , 50 , 70 , 90 , 100 } % r\in\{10,30,50,70,90,100\}\% . The corruption rate is defined relative to the number of tokeniser tokens in the clean corruption region: if the region contains N N tokens, then rate α \alpha modifies approximately α ​ N \alpha N tokens’ worth of content. For dropout, replacement, and spelling, eligible words are selected until the corresponding token mass reaches the target budget. For distractor corruption, α \alpha denotes the ratio of inserted distractor tokens to the original token count.
blocks.zh: 我们采用四种腐败模式,比例为 r { 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 100}% r\ 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 100} 腐败率是相对于干净的腐败地区象征性标志数量来定义的:如果该地区包含 N 标志,那么 α \ alpha 的比例会修改大约 α N \ alpha N 标志的内容价值. 对于退学、替换和拼写,选择合格的词,直到相应的符号质量达到目标预算。 对于调离器腐败,α\α表示插入的调离器令牌与原始令牌计数的比例.

blocks.en: 1. Dropout: Selected eligible words are deleted from the corruption region. Scaffold words and punctuation are protected. 2. Replacement: Selected eligible words are replaced with random high-frequency function words drawn from a fixed set ( "the" , "a" , "of" , "and" , etc.). Replacements that collide with the original word are re-sampled up to 10 times. 3. Spelling: Selected eligible words are misspelled by shuffling their internal characters while preserving the first and last characters. Words with ≤ 3 \leq 3 characters or uniform middle characters are skipped. This corruption preserves approximate word identity while disrupting exact tokenisation. 4. Distractor: Semantically irrelevant but syntactically well-formed sentences (e.g. "Fish swim." , "Trees grow." ) are interleaved into the corruption region at random positions until the target token budget is reached. Sentences are drawn from a fixed pool of 100 factual/common-sense statements.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 退学:从腐败地区删除选定的合格字。 脚手语与 p语皆受护. 2. 替换:选取的合格词用从固定集("the","a","of","and"等)抽取的随机高频函数词替换. 与原词相撞的替换器最多被重新取样10次. 3.拼写:选取的合格单词在保留首字母和末字母的同时打乱其内部字符时拼错. 3\leq 3字符或统一中间字符的单词被跳过 。 这种腐败保持了大约的文字特征,同时扰乱了确切的象征。 4. 困扰者:语义上无关,但从策略上讲是很好的句子(如"鱼游"). ,"Trees grow.")以随机位置进入腐败区域,直到达到目标符号预算. 刑期从100份事实陈述/常识陈述的固定集合中得出。

blocks.en: Dropout: Selected eligible words are deleted from the corruption region. Scaffold words and punctuation are protected.
blocks.zh: 退学:从腐败地区删除选定的合格字。 脚手语与 p语皆受护.

blocks.en: Replacement: Selected eligible words are replaced with random high-frequency function words drawn from a fixed set ( "the" , "a" , "of" , "and" , etc.). Replacements that collide with the original word are re-sampled up to 10 times.
blocks.zh: 替换:选取的合格词用从固定集("the","a","of","and"等)抽出的随机高频函数词替换. 与原词相撞的替换器最多被重新取样10次.

blocks.en: Spelling: Selected eligible words are misspelled by shuffling their internal characters while preserving the first and last characters. Words with ≤ 3 \leq 3 characters or uniform middle characters are skipped. This corruption preserves approximate word identity while disrupting exact tokenisation.
blocks.zh: 拼写:选取的合格单词通过在保留第一个和最后一个字符的同时打乱其内部字符来拼写错误. 3\leq 3字符或统一中间字符的单词被跳过 。 这种腐败保持了大约的文字特征,同时扰乱了确切的象征。

blocks.en: Distractor: Semantically irrelevant but syntactically well-formed sentences (e.g. "Fish swim." , "Trees grow." ) are interleaved into the corruption region at random positions until the target token budget is reached. Sentences are drawn from a fixed pool of 100 factual/common-sense statements.
blocks.zh: 沉滞者:语义上无关但战术上造型良好的句子(如"鱼游"). ,"Trees grow.")以随机位置进入腐败区域,直到达到目标符号预算. 刑期从100份事实陈述/常识陈述的固定集合中得出。

blocks.en: All corruption functions operate on word-level tokenisation, track the achieved corruption rate in model-specific tokens, and record which word positions were modified. Only dropout and replacement alter the number of tokens; spelling preserves token count approximately; distractor strictly adds tokens.
blocks.zh: 所有腐败职能都以字级符号化操作,跟踪在模型特定符号中实现的腐败率,并记录哪些字位被修改. 只有退出和替换才能改变符号的数量;拼写大约保留符号计数;分散符严格添加符号.

blocks.en: S2.5 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: S2.5 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate model outputs using greedy decoding with max_new_tokens=32 . Clean and corrupted predictions are generated in batches of 32 with left-padding. Clean predictions are cached per unique prompt to avoid redundant generation. We compute:
blocks.zh: 我们使用 max_new_tokens=32 的贪婪解码来评价模型输出 。 清洁和腐烂的预测分批产生,分批产生32个,用左铺. 干净的预测被缓存到每个独特的提示以避免冗余生成. 我们计算:

blocks.en: • Exact match (EM): Whether the normalised prediction exactly matches any gold answer. For multiple-choice tasks, we also accept the correct option letter (A/B/C/D/E). Normalisation lowercases, removes punctuation and articles, and collapses whitespace. • Token-level F1: Precision and recall computed over whitespace-tokenised normalised prediction and gold answer, taking the maximum over all gold answers. • Token agreement: Whether the normalised corrupted prediction matches the normalised clean prediction. This provides a label-free measure of whether corruption changed the model’s output. • Repair label: An example is labelled as “repaired” if F1 ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 . This threshold is used for all probe-based analyses.
blocks.zh: • 精确匹配(EM): 常态预测是否完全匹配任何金子答案 。 对于多个选择任务,我们也接受正确的选项字母(A/B/C/D/E). 规范化小写,去掉标点和文章,并崩溃白空间. • Token-level F1: 精确度和召回度计算在白空切入态的常态预测和金子答案上,对所有金子答案占最大比例。 • 支助 协议 常态化的腐败预测是否与常态化的清洁预测相匹配. 这为腐败是否改变了模型的输出提供了无标签的衡量标准. • 支助 修复标签 : 如果F1 = 0.5\geq 0.5,则将一个实例标为“修复”。 这个阈值用于所有基于探测的分析.

blocks.en: S2.6 Position-Group Activation Patching
blocks.zh: S2.6 定位组激活补丁

blocks.en: We adapt the patching methodology from the symbolic setting to pretrained models. Because dropout and distractor corruptions change the token count (making position-aligned patching impossible), we restrict patching analyses to replacement and spelling corruptions, which preserve sequence length.
blocks.zh: 我们把补丁方法从象征性的设置中修改为预先训练过的模型. 因为退出和分散注意力的腐败会改变符号计数(使位置对齐的补丁不可能),所以我们把补丁分析局限于替换和拼写腐败,这保持了序列长度.

blocks.en: For replacement and spelling modes, we tokenize both the clean and corrupted rendered prompts and compare token-by-token. The positions where the tokens differ are labeled “corrupted”; all other positions are “clean”. Examples where the clean and corrupted tokenisations have different lengths are excluded.
blocks.zh: 对于替换和拼写模式,我们表示干净和腐败的提示,并逐个比较。 符号不同的位置被标为“损坏”;所有其他位置都是“干净的”。 清洁和腐败的标志有不同长度的例子被排除在外。

blocks.en: For each example and each target layer ℓ \ell : 1. Run a clean forward pass, cache the layer- ℓ \ell activation h ℓ clean ∈ ℝ T × C h_{\ell}^{\mathrm{clean}}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times C} (moved to CPU to manage GPU memory). 2. Run a corrupted forward pass, record the corrupted-target logit. 3. Patch corrupted positions: Run the corrupted input through the model, but at layer ℓ \ell replace the activations in all the corrupted positions with the corresponding activations from the uncorrupted run. Record the patched-target logit and the raw logit change. 4. Patch clean positions: Same procedure, but replace activations at all clean (non-corrupted) positions.

blocks.en: This yields two scalars per (example, layer): the logit changes from patching corrupted positions to patching clean positions. We report the mean absolute logit change per position, averaged within each group.

blocks.en: S2.7 Cosine Similarity and Repair Probes
blocks.zh: S2.7 余弦相似性和修理探测器

At each probed layer ℓ \ell , we extract the hidden state at the final token position as a single vector h ℓ [ p , : ] ∈ ℝ C h_{\ell}[p,:]\in\mathbb{R}^{C} , cast to float32. blocks.en: S2.8 Linearization Scale Test
blocks.zh: S2.8 线化缩放试验

blocks.en: The linearization test follows the same procedure as in the symbolic setting (Appendix S1.13 ), with the following adaptations for HuggingFace models:
blocks.zh: 线性化测试遵循与符号设置(Appendix S1.13 )中相同的程序,对HuggingFace模型进行了以下修改: 1.

blocks.en: A forward hook on the target layer captures the hidden state and sets requires_grad=True on the output tensor. The target-token logit (argmax of the clean prediction at the final position) is backpropagated to obtain the gradient ∇ h g ∈ ℝ C \nabla_{h}g\in\mathbb{R}^{C} .
blocks.zh: 目标层上的前钩捕捉隐藏状态,设置需要_grad=True在输出计数器上. 目标对数(在最后位置为清洁预测的弧形)被反射,以获得梯度 QQ h g QR C\nabla_{h}g\in\ mathbb{R}^{C} (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: For efficiency, all four α \alpha values ( { 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1.0 } \{0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0\} ) are evaluated in a single batched forward pass. The clean input is replicated 4 times and a hook adds the perturbation α ⋅ e \alpha\cdot e at the final position for each batch element. This avoids 4 separate forward passes per example.
blocks.zh: 为提高效率,所有四个α-α值({0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0}}{0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0})都是在单批前传中评价的. 清洁的输入被复制4次,并在每批元素的最后位置加上扰动α e\ alpha\cdot e. 这样就避免了每例4个单独的前传。

blocks.en: Both clean and corrupted forward passes use their respective attention masks. The corrupted pass uses the corrupted attention mask; the patched passes use the clean attention mask (since patching modifies hidden states within the clean computation graph).
blocks.zh: 干净和腐败的前进通道都使用各自的注意力罩。 腐烂的通行证使用腐烂的注意力罩;补丁的通行证使用干净的注意力罩(因为补丁在干净的计算图中修改了隐藏状态).

blocks.en: For computational efficiency, the linearization test is run at every 10th layer plus the second-to-last layer.
blocks.zh: 为了计算效率,线性化测试每10层运行一次,外加第二层至最后一层.

blocks.en: Repair labels (correct/incorrect) are drawn from the pre-computed evaluation metrics (EM and F1), not from the linearization test’s own predictions. This ensures consistency across all analyses.
blocks.zh: 修补标签(正确/不正确)来自预计算评价指标(EM和F1),而不是线化测试本身的预测。 这确保所有分析的一致性。

blocks.en: S5 Additional figures
blocks.zh: S5 额外数字

blocks.en: Figure 12: Accuracy versus ablation percentage across toy model sizes, corruption modes and task families.
blocks.zh: 图12:玩具模型大小、腐败模式和任务家庭的准确度与消耗率。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Clean baseline exact-match performance of the pretrained models across the factual QA, ARC, and CommonsenseQA task families before any corruption is applied.
blocks.zh: 图13:在适用任何腐败行为之前,经过预先培训的模型在实际质量评估、ARC和CommonsenseQA任务家庭中的准确表现是清净的基线。

blocks.en: Figure 14: Representative degradation curves for pretrained models. Exact match (EM) is plotted versus ablation rate across task families and model sizes, illustrating that dropout and replacement are generally the most damaging corruptions while distractor-style corruption is typically milder.
blocks.zh: 图 14:预训模型的代表性降解曲线. 精确匹配(EM)是精心策划的,相对于任务家族和模型规模的膨胀率而言,这表明辍学和替代通常是最具破坏性的腐败,而分散注意力的腐败通常更为温和。

blocks.en: Figure 15: Cumulative repair concentration in the large toy model for sequence length 80, the zero corruption mode, and 30% ablation. Positions are sorted by their per-position patching effect before the residual addition; the steep initial rise shows that a small subset of positions carries most of the total repair signal.
blocks.zh: 图15:序列长度80的大型玩具模型中累计修复浓度,零腐败模式,以及30%膨胀率. 位置在剩余添加之前按每个位置的补丁效应排序;陡峭的初始上升表明,一小块位置携带了全部修复信号的大部分.

blocks.en: Figure 16: Example-level per-position patching map for the large toy model before the residual addition. Each panel shows the raw logit change across positions at a different layer, illustrating how early effects stay near corrupted locations and later effects spread toward output-relevant positions.
blocks.zh: 图16:剩余添加前大型玩具模型的示例级/位置补丁图. 每个面板显示不同层位置的原始对数变化,说明早期效应如何停留在腐败地点附近,后来效应如何蔓延到与产出有关的位置。

blocks.en: Figure 17: Repair signal with and without the final position. Mean absolute logit change from patching attention outputs at corrupted and clean positions across layers. Left: all eligible positions, including the final sequence position. Right: the final position is excluded.
blocks.zh: 图17:有和无最后位置的修复信号。 平均绝对对数变化来自在层层的腐败和干净位置上补合注意力输出。 左:所有符合条件的职位,包括最终序列位置. 对:最后位置被排除在外.

blocks.en: Figure 18: Prediction restoration under position-group patching in pretrained models. This reports the probability that patching corrupted or clean positions restores the clean prediction, for each model across corruption modes and task families.
blocks.zh: 图 18:在预训型号的定位组补丁下进行预测修复. 报告显示,对腐败模式和任务家庭的每一种模式,修补腐败或干净的位置都有可能恢复干净的预测。

blocks.en: Figure 19: Cosine similarity between clean and corrupted activations (hooked after LayerNorm block) in the large toy model. Repaired examples remain closely aligned across depth and as corruption increases, whereas failed examples drift away, especially at the final layer.
blocks.zh: 图 19:在大型玩具模型中,清洁激活和腐败激活(在LayerNorm块之后)的余弦相似性. 修复后的例子在深度和腐败增加时仍然密切配合,而失败的例子却逐渐消失,特别是在最后一层。

blocks.en: Figure 20: Repair-success probes in toy models. This shows layer-wise AUC for predicting whether a corrupted example is ultimately answered correctly in the large and small models, respectively, comparing linear and cosine readouts across zero, in-range, and out-of-range ablation modes.
blocks.zh: 图20 玩具模型中的修复成功探测器. 这显示了一个已损坏的示例最终在大模型和小模型中分别得到正确解答的分层AUC,比较了零,内程,外程衰减模式的线性读出和余弦读出.

blocks.en: Figure 21: Corruption-detection probes in toy models. This shows layer-wise AUC for predicting whether an input was corrupted in the large and small models, respectively; unlike repair-success prediction, corruption identity becomes strongly linearly decodable only after several layers.
blocks.zh: 图21:玩具模型中的腐败探测器. 这表明一个输入在大模型和小模型中是否分别被腐蚀的AUC分层;与修复-成功预测不同的是,腐败身份只有在几层之后才会变得强烈的线性解码.

blocks.en: Figure 22: Representative repair-success probes in pretrained models. Layer-wise AUC predicts whether a corrupted example will still be answered correctly, comparing linear and cosine probes across corruption modes for ARC.
blocks.zh: 图22 预训型号中的代表性修理-成功探测器. 从层到层的AUC预测一个腐败的例子是否会仍然被正确解答,为ARC比较跨腐败模式的线性和余弦探测.

blocks.en: Figure 23: Linearization residuals in the large toy model. Repaired examples stay close to locally linear behavior near the clean trajectory, while failed examples show much larger residuals at larger interpolation steps and higher corruption levels.
blocks.zh: 图23 大玩具模型中的线化残基. 修复过的例子接近当地线性行为接近干净的轨迹,而失败的例子显示,在更大的内插步骤和更高的腐败水平上,残余物要大得多。

blocks.en: Figure 24: Linearization residuals in pretrained models. This shows mean absolute linearization error as a function of interpolation step size and corruption level; repaired and failed examples separate most clearly at large α \alpha and in later layers.
blocks.zh: 图24 预训型号中的线化残基. 这显示了绝对线性化错误作为插值步数和腐败水平的函数;修复和失败的例子在大α\α和后层最明显地分开.

blocks.en: Figure 25: Additional pretrained-model linearization residuals. This shows mean absolute linearization error as a function of interpolation step size and corruption level for the remaining evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 图25:新增预训型线性化残基. 这表明了绝对线性化错误作为其余被评价模型的插值步数和腐败程度的一个函数。

blocks.en: Figure 26: Finetuning on corrupted inputs differentially improves the robustness of an LLM.
blocks.zh: 图26:对腐败投入的微调有差别地改进了LLM的稳健性.

blocks.en: Figure 27: Earliest-layer probe performance by model and corruption mode. Cells show ROC-AUC and 10%-budget recall lift; asterik indicates bootstrap 95% CI above chance.
blocks.zh: 图27:按模型和腐败模式分列的厄里最高级探测器的性能. 单元格显示ROC-AUC和10%的预算召回升力;asterik表示比机会高95%CI。

blocks.en: Figure 28: Fine-tuning reduces displacement-normalized linearization error across interpolation steps, with the largest reduction at moderate corruption levels.
blocks.zh: 图28:精细调整可减少跨插值步骤的流离常态线性化误差,在中度腐败水平下减少幅度最大.
